product_contract: Build/Buy work maintains one durable, revisioned lot environment model that accumulates observations and mutation outcomes recursively. Agents plan the next move from that model; they never wipe understanding and reassess from a blank slate after each action. Checkpoints persist the current model revision (and optional Save As) for recovery — they are continuity of understanding, not extract-from-scratch rituals.
motivating_corrections: 2026-11-07 Bargain Bend: Hand+Backspace sweeps rearranged the lot without durable understanding or recoverable state, destroying usable layout for BI-002 testing.
2026-11-07 operator: do not build → act → extract checkpoint from scratch → reassess; accumulate environment understanding recursively as you move.

rejected.why: Each turn discards prior layout knowledge, re-captures from zero, and re-plans as if the lot were unknown — wastes proof and causes destructive thrash.
A photo/receipt without a structured accumulating model still forces reassessment; recovery exists but agency does not compound.
Inventing exact object IDs/poses from screenshots alone is false precision; model stores attested/observed claims with confidence ceilings.

library_checkpoint.rule: admit_mutation must LIBRARY_ADMIT before room/structure leases; Save As is not a substitute

success: observe(claims) -> merge into same model; bump revision
if room/structure work pending without fresh library_checkpoint -> SAVE_TO_LIBRARY
attest_library_save after observed My Library confirmation
plan_next(model) -> one action grounded in entities/goals
admit_mutation(model.revision, action) -> library then integrity/spatial lease OR DENIED
observe(outcome_delta) -> recursive update; do not recreate model
persist_checkpoint(model) -> continuity receipt + optional Save As

recovery_policy.if_lot_destroyed_and_good_save_exists: LOAD_LAST_KNOWN_GOOD_SAVE; do not Save over it with wreckage
recovery_policy.if_only_wreckage_loaded: Save As wreckage under a distinct BI_TMP_ label only if operator wants a forensic copy, then load prior good save or restart lab lot
recovery_policy.never: Overwrite a known-good play save with a rearranged wreckage session
recovery_policy.model_after_load: Seed a new model revision from the loaded save; do not pretend prior wreckage model is still authoritative
